quests.title: The Uncounted King

find.text: The harbour-master's chain-log has a line where the same barge sails at night, three times a month, with a manifest that reads only 'stone dust, chisels, one priest'.

quests.desc: A barge with only stone dust, chisels and a priest on its manifest sails from Aldhaven by night.
quests.pitch: The chain-keeper at Aldhaven Harbor says the same barge leaves every ninth night, riding low and quiet.

objectives.text: Take the mason's apron from the Glenpoint boat-shed to Wayrest.
Take the Quiet Chisel's payment list from Wayrest's archives.
Convince the Daggerfall scribe to part with his marginal genealogy.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The masons' trail crosses three crowns and a cursed crypt, and ends in the tomb of the lost kings.

quests.title: The Uncounted King (II)
quests.desc: The masons' trail crosses three crowns and a cursed crypt, and ends in the tomb of the lost kings.
quests.pitch: The chain-keeper at Aldhaven Harbor says the same barge leaves every ninth night, riding low and quiet.

objectives.text: Copy the half-erased inscription in the lower chapel of Camlorn's cathedral.
Break the plaster in the Cath Bedraud niche and read the buried name.
Reach the sealed eighth king-room before the master-mason finishes the wall.

quests.outro: The eighth king's name was almost gone, scraped to a ghost in the stone. I traced it in charcoal before the masons returned. What three crowns do with it is theirs to decide.

quests.title: Cream-Coloured Invitations

find.text: A cream-coloured card lies on the inn's single table, perfumed with plum. 'You are cordially invited. Dress as you were when you were happiest. Do not bring your lantern.'

quests.desc: A perfumed invitation on the table of a one-lamp inn says to leave your lantern behind.
quests.pitch: The innkeeper says every guest who stayed the night is gone, and leaves a card on the table.

objectives.text: Take the shrine's candle-end ward to the fog-bound port of Northpoint.
Take the silver bell from the Northpoint harbour-master toward Shornhelm.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The guest-list led from a hamlet shrine and a fog-bound port to a black spire and on to the party itself.

quests.title: Cream-Coloured Invitations (II)
quests.desc: The guest-list led from a hamlet shrine and a fog-bound port to a black spire and on to the party itself.
quests.pitch: The innkeeper says every guest who stayed the night is gone, and leaves a card on the table.

objectives.text: Take the plum-ink guest-book from the Shornhelm keep's cellars.
Take the necromancer's second ledger and find the Host's door.
Enter the demesne and decline the Host's final invitation.

quests.outro: The hall was warm, music still playing, the table laid. No one asked me to leave. It was the hardest door I have ever closed behind me.

quests.title: Names Before Death

find.text: A freshly chiselled name stands at the foot of the palisade, with a date nine days ahead. Below, in Orcish letters: 'Carved by no hand.' The stronghold's smith has covered it with a hide.

quests.desc: A name has been carved at the stronghold gate with a date nine days ahead.
quests.pitch: The smith at the Morkul stronghold keeps a hide over a stone that gets a new name each dusk.

objectives.text: Take the rubbing of the newest names to the broken ridge of the Wrothgarian peaks.
Follow the wrong-way shadow down to the rebuilt city.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The column's unseen carver leads through the broken ridge and the rebuilt city to the first city's cold forge.

quests.title: Names Before Death (II)
quests.desc: The column's unseen carver leads through the broken ridge and the rebuilt city to the first city's cold forge.
quests.pitch: The smith at the Morkul stronghold keeps a hide over a stone that gets a new name each dusk.

objectives.text: Find the sealed door below Orsinium's forge-pits and descend.
Stand at the anvil in Old Orsinium and take the hammer from the smith-spirit.

quests.outro: The forge-spirit stilled its hammer as I broke the last unlit name on the anvil. I do not know whether it will begin again, but the names on the column are, for now, only names.

quests.title: The Giant That Drinks

find.text: A fisherman's totem at the lighthouse base has been wired with a small brass drip-cup. Scratched on it: 'The tide is wrong. The giant is drinking again. Ask Evermor.'

quests.desc: A fisherman's totem says the tide is wrong because a giant has begun to drink again.
quests.pitch: Koeglin fishermen say their nets come up full of salt water where there is no sea.

objectives.text: Taste the giant's tears and follow the water toward the lake city.
Take the engineer's flooding survey from Evermor to the ring of towers on Balfiera.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The giant's thirst runs from a lake city and a ring of towers to a Dwemer pump and the old Direnni seat.

quests.title: The Giant That Drinks (II)
quests.desc: The giant's thirst runs from a lake city and a ring of towers to a Dwemer pump and the old Direnni seat.
quests.pitch: Koeglin fishermen say their nets come up full of salt water where there is no sea.

objectives.text: Take the key-bar from the lock tower on Balfiera to the Dwemer bastion at Mthartzel.
Reach the pump hall at Mthartzel and silence the Keeper.
Climb to the lens room and meet the last Direnni heir.

quests.outro: The pump fell silent and the great stone chest of the giant sighed one last time. In the bay, the ring of towers on Balfiera slowly lifted toward the sun.
